authorityRules.USER_REPORTED: Requires canonical input/evidence reference; remains user-reported fact.
authorityRules.SYSTEM_CALCULATED: Requires deterministic runtime/calculation reference; is not interpretation.
authorityRules.SYSTEM_INTERPRETED: Requires governed interpretation/readout authority and source lineage; raw data plus LLM is forbidden.
authorityRules.PROFESSIONAL_OBSERVED: Requires PR record and explicit human attribution.
